about_the_game:
🌟 Embark on the Path of Immortality

Talent alone is not enough to become a powerful cultivator. You'll need legendary artifacts, mystical abilities, powerful techniques, loyal spirit pets, and a touch of fate. Only by joining a mighty sect and becoming a true disciple can you begin to ascend the path to immortality!

🎮 Game Overview

Paper Realm: Path of the Immortal is a Roguelike survival strategy game set in a world of Eastern cultivation. Inspired by Brotato's exhilarating combat and classic roguelite growth systems, it combines thrilling gameplay with a unique paper-sculpted visual style. Characters and environments appear like 3D paper carvings, brought to life with shifting light and shadow to create a serene yet mystical fantasy world.

Play as a cultivator striving to survive wave after wave of incoming beasts. Master divine arts, refine artifacts, practice powerful techniques, join sects, trigger random events, and tame spirit beasts — all in the name of survival and ascension!

🧭 Game Features

🌿 Cultivation & Survival Challenge

Between each wave of enemies, you’ll enter the "Guizang Interface", a moment of respite where you can spend Lingyun (the core resource) to:

  • Learn new abilities

  • Refine powerful artifacts

  • Cultivate inner techniques

  • Join sects

  • Encounter random events

  • Tame spirit beasts

Unique and diverse Divine Arts: These skills are automatically cast during combat and come in many forms, such as:

  • Homing sword strikes

  • Giant blade slashes

  • Brutal dashes in a straight line

  • Black hole artifacts that pull enemies in

  • Ice spells that slow down enemies

Technique progression: Different techniques enhance different attributes — some increase your power after every kill, some speed up your EXP gain, while others grant unique passive effects.

👤 Multiple Characters × Diverse Builds

Choose from a variety of characters, each with distinct talents and innate divine arts.

As your character reaches higher cultivation realms, their talent tree unfolds, allowing deep customization:

  • Build an ultra-tanky warrior who reflects damage

  • Become a berserker who grows stronger the more damage they take

  • Play a high-damage spellcaster or a battle-hardened spell-tank

  • Mix and match — your imagination is the limit!

🏯 Sect Legacy System

Mo Rock Valley: Focuses on defense and strength. Powerful techniques come with heavy trade-offs.

Void Sword Sect: Specializes in sword arts, boosting spell power and spiritual force. Ideal for long-range suppression.

More sects coming soon!

🕹️ Simple Controls, Deep Strategy

  • Just move your character — divine arts auto-cast when enemies enter range.

  • Easy to pick up even for casual or one-handed play.

  • Fast-paced 30-minute game runs with increasing wave difficulty.

  • Supports local 2-player co-op — team up with a friend and survive together!

🌌 "In the paper realm, seek the Dao — survive to ascend."

Survive the beast tides and transcend your limits in a beautifully crafted world of paper and cultivation.

🎉 More characters, divine arts, techniques, items, and sects are on the way —
Add to your Wishlist and join us on this path to immortality!

short_description: "Paper Xian" is a xianxia roguelike survival game featuring unique paper-cut art. Defend against 20 monster waves with auto-attacks, upgrade skills between rounds, and join sects for special boosts. Enjoy fast 30-min runs with local co-op support. More characters & sects coming soon!
